structures.description: Two-sided congestion in the first third of the window: 42 bars of heavy overlap holding between the 2411.04 low (1789041600000) and the 2528.8 high (1788739200000), with no sustained close outside that band.

Bull breakout leg out of that congestion: closes of 2578.6 (1789732800000) and 2636.28 (1789747200000) cleared the prior swing high 2609.02 (1789416000000), and the close 2723.15 (1789977600000) cleared the 2680 spike high (1789128000000); price has held above those levels since.

Bull channel from the 2358.62 low (1789488000000): 35 bars of higher highs and higher lows with overlapping bars and shallow 3-5 bar pullbacks (lows 2370.54 at 1789574400000, 2438.33 at 1789675200000, 2568.16 at 1789891200000; highs 2481.66, 2585.5, 2700, 2850).

Possible buy-climax spike: 1789977600000 printed 2658.06-2850 and closed at 2723.15, leaving a 126.85-point upper tail; the next three bars stayed inside that bar's range with rising lows and rising closes but no test of 2850.

evidence_for: Closes have cleared each prior ceiling and held: 2636.28 above the 2609.02 swing high (1789416000000) and 2723.15 above the 2680 spike high (1789128000000).

The 1789862400000-1789891200000 pullback (2700 to 2568.16, about 132 points) held far above the prior swing low 2438.33, and the last three bars hold above the midpoint of the 1789977600000 spike bar with rising closes.
evidence_against: 1789977600000 closed in the lower third of a 191.94-point range with a 126.85-point upper tail at 2850, the shape of a climax/exhaustion spike rather than clean breakout follow-through.
No close above 2804.59 since the spike, and 2804.59 (1790020800000 high) is still 45.41 below 2850, so the spike extreme is untested.

Measured across all 120 bars the window is a broad 2357.18-2850 box and price is now at its upper boundary; the previous spike in the same vicinity (2680 at 1789128000000) was fully reversed into the 2358.62 low.
An earlier spike already failed in this window: 1788436800000 ran 2404.35-2509.15 and closed 2506.79, then 1788523200000 erased the move and closed 2450.96.
transition_conditions: Trend confirmation: a close above 2850 followed by a bar that holds above 2804.59, plus a higher low above 2759.63, would support continued bull trend/channel.

Spike failure: a close below 2658.06 (low of 1789977600000) and then below 2568.16 (low of 1789891200000) would indicate the spike failed and raise the risk of an mtr-like lower high at the 2850 test.

If the 1789992000000-1790020800000 tail expands into a tight band and one side breaks on a wide bar, read that resolution as a fresh breakout; continued overlapping bars between roughly 2718.09 and 2804.59 keep the read as a pause after the spike.
A close back below 2609.02 (prior swing high, 1789416000000) would return price into the old range and weaken the bull-trend classification toward trading-range.
